subject: dsa
title: Swim in Rising Water
summary: Water rises over time. The least time to cross equals the smallest possible maximum elevation along any path from the top-left to the bottom-right.
problem: Water rises over time. At time t you may enter any cell with elevation at most t. Find the least time at which a path exists from the top-left to the bottom-right. This equals the smallest possible maximum elevation along a path.

steps.caption: Find the least time at which water lets you reach the bottom-right corner.
The destination has elevation 2, so the time must be at least 2.
At time 2, the path across the top then down the right uses only cells of elevation at most 2. The 8 is impassable.
Done. That path works at time 2, so the answer is 2.
